entries.title: Closing a card asks right under the ×
entries.body: When you close a card after picking answers, a small question now opens under the × you clicked: "You picked 2 answers. Closing will discard them." Choose Keep answering or Discard and close. The card's own buttons no longer change, and Escape or a click anywhere else keeps the card open.

picture.alt: A decision card with a small question under its × reading You picked 2 answers. Closing will discard them., with Keep answering and Discard and close
